findings.problem: Scorer-only labels could change without changing request hashes, because run/report did not enforce a digest binding for suite.json. Execution source and authored input hashes were recorded but not checked.
findings.resolution: The preparation plan now freezes suite, catalog, inventory, runtime source hashes and source input hashes. Preparation, execution, resume and reporting verify those bindings.

findings.problem: A returned answer type different from the request could be accepted and silently interpreted as an inactive role. Categorical answers and optional noul scalar could disagree with the probabilities.
findings.resolution: decode_answers validates exact question coverage, requested type, finite numeric normalized probabilities, false-first categorical argmax including ties, and any returned noul scalar.

findings.problem: Resume and report trusted saved selected/probability fields after checking only the request hash, and did not require a corresponding pinned model session.
findings.resolution: Saved records are re-derived from complete raw output and require completed inference plus a valid model session. Resumed sessions must share the pinned revision, weight hash, strict encoding settings, and all checkpoint file hashes.

confirmed_contracts: The payload submitted to predict contains state and questions only. State has task and artifacts; expected labels, team required/allowed sets, case rationale and evidence are absent.
Cached typed.py converts question objects into state/question/type/options rows; role identifiers remain response metadata and are not model tokens.
Both variants serialize options false then true. Noul uses probability >=0.5; categorical choice uses argmax with false winning an exact tie, matching the cached implementation.
Missing question outputs invalidate the whole request. Failed individual output is unavailable rather than negative; an incomplete team is never scored.
Allowed team additions are not false positives. Missing mandatory roles and forbidden additions are independently counted.
load_julia disables downloads, pins the checkpoint revision and weight SHA-256, and records cache file hashes. All model calls are offline.
Strict encoding checks the 48-token option contract, lossless head budget and 8192-token total budget. The 22-lens team is 22 independent binary questions, not a 22-option winner selection.
Existing frozen outputs are preserved on resume; malformed or inconsistent artifacts fail closed instead of being silently regenerated.

verification.initial_environment_failure: Two temporary-directory checks initially hit the Windows sandbox default temp restriction; they now use owned, verified directories under the benchmark workspace and pass.

limitations: This review and these tests do not establish model accuracy or real reviewer effectiveness.
Hash bindings protect recorded run consistency, not a malicious actor able to replace the plan and every bound artifact.
Interrupted or corrupt artifact writes fail closed and require explicit recovery; completed outputs are not automatically discarded or rerun.
